Mary, mother of Jesus: Nwanyị Na-amaghị Nwoke Nsọ Meri, Nne Chineke na Nne nke Nzukọ, onye a họpụtara site na mgbe ebighị ebi ka ọ mụọ Onye Nzọpụta. A tụrụ ime ya n'enweghị mmehie, ọ bụkwa nwa agbọghọ na-amaghị nwoke mgbe niile; e welitere ya n'eluigwe n'ahụ na mkpụrụ obi.
Our Lady of Guadalupe: Na 1531 Nwanyị Na-amaghị Nwoke A Gọziri Agọzi pụtara ìhè nye Nsọ Juan Diego n'ugwu Tepeyac dị nso n'obodo Mexico, hapụ onyinyo ya n'uwe mkpuchi ya. Ọ bụ Onye Nchekwa nke Amerika.
Our Lady of Fátima: Na 1917 Nwanyị Na-amaghị Nwoke A Gọziri Agọzi pụtara ìhè nye ụmụaka atọ na-azụ atụrụ na Fatima, Portugal, kpọọ ụwa òkù ka ha kpee ekpere, chegharịa, na-ekpe Rosari kwa ụbọchị ma rara onwe ha nye Obi ya Na-enweghị Ntụpọ.
Our Lady of Lourdes: Na 1858 Nwanyị Na-amaghị Nwoke A Gọziri Agọzi pụtara ìhè nye Nsọ Bernadette ugboro iri na asatọ na Lourdes, France, sị: "Abụ m Onye A Tụrụ Ime Ya N'enweghị Mmehie." Isi iyi ya aghọwo ebe ọgwụgwọ na njem nsọ kemgbe ahụ.
Our Lady of Aparecida: Na 1717 ndị ọkụ azụ chọtara n'osimiri Paraíba obere ihe oyiyi nke Onye A Tụrụ Ime Ya N'enweghị Mmehie, ụgbụ ha tọgbọrọ chakoo jupụtakwara n'azụ. Meri nke Aparecida bụ Eze Nwanyị na Onye Nchekwa nke Brazil.
Our Mother of Perpetual Help: Nne Anyị nke Enyemaka Na-adịgide Adịgide
Onyinyo nsọ ochie na-egosi Nwa Jizọs ka ọ na-agbaga n'aka Nne ya mgbe ọ hụrụ ngwa ọrụ nke Ahụhụ ya. Onye A Gọziri Agọzi Pius IX nyefere ya ndị Redemptorist na 1866 ka ha mee ka a mara ya n'ụwa niile.
Our Lady of the Pillar: Ọdịnala na-ekwu na Nwanyị Na-amaghị Nwoke A Gọziri Agọzi bịakwutere Nsọ Jems Onyeozi na Zaragoza ka o mee ka ozizi ya na Spain sie ike, hapụ ogidi dịka akara. Ọ bụ Onye Nchekwa nke Spain na ndị na-asụ Spanish.
Our Lady of Mount Carmel: Meri dịka Nne na Onye Nchekwa nke Otu ndị Kamelaịt. O nyere Nsọ Simon Stock Skapula na-acha aja aja dịka akara nchekwa ya nye ndị niile na-eyi ya n'okwukwe.
Our Lady of the Rosary: Mmemme a na-echeta mmeri na Lepanto na 1571, nke e nwetara mgbe ndị kwere ekwe na-ekpe Rosari. Ọ na-akpọ anyị ka anyị tụgharịa uche n'ihe omimi nke Kraịst ya na Nne ya.
Our Lady of Sorrows: Ọ na-asọpụrụ ikere òkè nke Nne A Gọziri Agọzi n'Ahụhụ Nwa ya site na mwute ya asaa, site n'amụma Simiọn ruo n'olili Jizọs. O guzoro n'ikwesị ntụkwasị obi n'okpuru Obe.
Immaculate Conception: Site n'amara pụrụ iche nke Chineke, e chebere Nwanyị Na-amaghị Nwoke Nsọ Meri pụọ na mmehie mbụ site na mgbe mbụ a tụrụ ime ya. Ọ bụ mmemme onye nchekwa nke Amerika.
Assumption of Mary: Na njedebe nke ndụ ya n'ụwa, e welitere Nwanyị Na-amaghị Nwoke Nsọ Meri n'ahụ na mkpụrụ obi n'ebube nke eluigwe, dịka Pope Pius XII kwupụtara n'ụzọ gọọmentị na 1950.
Sacred Heart: Fraịdee na-esote Sọnde nke abụọ mgbe Pentikọst gasịrị
Nraranye nye Obi Nsọ nke Jizọs na-asọpụrụ ịhụnanya ya na-ere ọkụ nye mmadụ. Onyenwe anyị kpughere Nsọ Margaret Mary Alacoque nkwa ya n'afọ 1670.
Holy Family: Jizọs, Meri na Josef n'ụlọ ha dị na Nazaret, ihe nlereanya nye ezinụlọ Ndị Kraịst ọ bụla n'okwukwe, n'ịhụnanya na n'irubere Chineke isi.
Trinity: Ihe omimi kachasị nke okwukwe anyị: otu Chineke n'Ime Mmadụ atọ dị nsọ, Nna, Ọkpara na Mmụọ Nsọ.
Holy Spirit in Christianity: Onye nke atọ n'ime Atọ n'Ime Otu Nsọ, Onyenwe anyị na Onye na-enye ndụ, onye rịdatara n'isi Ndịozi na Pentikọst ma na-edo Nzukọ nsọ.
Christ the King: Pope Pius XI guzobere mmemme ukwu a na 1925 iji kwupụta ọchịchị Jizọs Kraịst n'obi ọ bụla, ezinụlọ na mba.
Divine Mercy: Nraranye nye ịhụnanya ebere Chineke e kpughere Nsọ Faustina Kowalska, nke e chịkọtara n'ekpere "Jizọs, a tụkwasịrị m gị obi." Nsọ Jọn Pọl II guzobere Sọnde Ebere Chineke na 2000.
Santo Niño de Cebú: Ihe oyiyi nke Nwa Nsọ Jizọs e nyere n'oge baptizim nke eze nwanyị Cebu na 1521, ihe oyiyi Ndị Kraịst kacha ochie na Philippines.
Juan Diego: Nsọ Juan Diego Cuauhtlatoatzin, onye obodo dị umeala n'obi chegharịrị, onye Nne Anyị nke Guadalupe pụtaara ìhè na 1531. Nsọ Jọn Pọl II mere ya onye nsọ na 2002.
Kateri Tekakwitha: "Okooko Lili nke ndị Mohawk" (1656–1680), nwa agbọghọ chegharịrị, dị ọcha ma na-ekpe ekpere nke ukwuu, onye nsọ mbụ si n'ụmụ amaala North America.
Martin de Porres: Nwanne nwoke Dominikan na Lima, Peru (1579–1639), a ma ama maka nlekọta ya dị umeala n'obi nye ndị ọrịa na ndị ogbenye nke agbụrụ niile. Onye Nchekwa ikpe ziri ezi n'etiti mmadụ.
Francis Xavier: Otu n'ime ndị Jesuit mbụ, o butere Oziọma na India, ndịda ọwụwa anyanwụ na ọwụwa anyanwụ Eshia na Japan, mee baptizim puku kwụrụ puku. Onye Nchekwa ndị ozi ala ọzọ.
Francis de Sales: Bishọp nke Geneva na Onye Nkuzi nke Nzukọ (1567–1622), onye kuziri na a na-akpọ onye ọ bụla òkù ka ọ dị nsọ. Onye Nchekwa ndị ode akwụkwọ na ndị nta akụkọ.
Saint Joseph: Di nke Nwanyị Na-amaghị Nwoke Nsọ Meri na nna na-azụ Jizọs, onye ezi omume chebere Ezinụlọ Nsọ. Onye Nchekwa nke Nzukọ niile, ndị nna, ndị ọrụ na ọnwụ dị mma.
Saint Patrick: Bishọp na Onyeozi nke Ireland na narị afọ nke ise. E bulara ya na Ireland dịka ohu mgbe ọ bụ nwata, ọ laghachikwara dịka onye ozi ala ọzọ butere agwaetiti ahụ n'okwukwe.
Anthony of Padua: Ụkọchukwu Fransiskan na Onye Nkuzi nke Nzukọ (1195–1231), onye nkwusa dị ike na onye na-arụ ọrụ ebube. Onye Nchekwa ndị ogbenye na ihe furu efu.
Francis of Assisi: Onye guzobere ndị Fransiskan (1181–1226), onye nabatara ịda ogbenye iji soro Kraịst nweta ọnya Onyenwe anyị. Onye Nchekwa nke Italy na anụmanụ.
John the Baptist: Onye na-ebute ụzọ Onyenwe anyị, onye kwusara nchegharị, mee Jizọs baptizim n'Osimiri Jọdan ma nye ndụ ya dịka onye nwụrụ n'ihi eziokwu.
Michael (archangel): Nsọ Maịkel Onyeisi Ndị Mmụọ Ozi
Onyeisi usuu ndị agha nke eluigwe, onye na-echebe ndị Chineke pụọ n'ọnyà Setan. Onye Nchekwa ndị agha, ndị uwe ojii na ndị ọrịa.
Raphael (archangel): Nsọ Rafael Onyeisi Ndị Mmụọ Ozi
Onyeisi ndị mmụọ ozi duru Tobias ma gwọọ Tobit; aha ya pụtara "Chineke na-agwọ." Onye Nchekwa ndị njem na ọgwụgwọ.
Gabriel: Nsọ Gabriel Onyeisi Ndị Mmụọ Ozi
Onyeisi ndị mmụọ ozi gwara Nwanyị Na-amaghị Nwoke Meri na ọ ga-abụ Nne nke Ọkpara Chineke. Onye Nchekwa ndị ozi.
Saint Peter: Onyeisi Ndịozi na Pope mbụ, onye Kraịst nyere mkpịsị igodo nke Alaeze. E gburu ya dịka onye nwụrụ n'ihi okwukwe na Rom, ọ dịkwa n'okpuru Basilika Nsọ Pita.
Paul the Apostle: Onyeozi nke Ndị Mba Ọzọ, onye chegharịrị n'ụzọ Damaskọs. Njem ya na akwụkwọ ozi ya butere Oziọma n'ụwa Rom niile, e gbukwara ya dịka onye nwụrụ n'ihi okwukwe na Rom.
Saint Anne: Nne nke Nwanyị Na-amaghị Nwoke Nsọ Meri na nne nne Jizọs, a na-asọpụrụ ya na Nsọ Joakim. Onye Nchekwa ndị nne na ndị nne nne.
Thérèse of Lisieux: Nwanyị Nsọ Kamelaịt na Onye Nkuzi nke Nzukọ (1873–1897), Obere Okooko, onye kuziri "obere ụzọ" nke ntụkwasị obi na ịhụnanya. Onye Nchekwa ndị ozi ala ọzọ.
Jude the Apostle: Onyeozi na onye ikwu Onyenwe anyị, onye dere Akwụkwọ Ozi Jud. Onye Nchekwa ihe enweghị olileanya.
Vincent de Paul: Ụkọchukwu France (1581–1660) guzobere Otu Ozi na Ụmụ Nwanyị nke Ọrụ Ebere. Onye Nchekwa ọrụ ebere niile.
Thomas Aquinas: Ụkọchukwu Dominikan na Onye Nkuzi nke Nzukọ (1225–1274), onye dere Summa Theologiae. Onye Nchekwa ụlọ akwụkwọ Katọlik na ụmụ akwụkwọ.
Rita of Cascia: Nwunye, nne, nwanyị di ya nwụrụ na nwanyị nsọ Ọgọstinian (1381–1457) nke jiri ndidi ukwu tachie ahụhụ obi. Onye Nchekwa ihe na-agaghị ekwe omume.
Augustine of Hippo: Bishọp na Onye Nkuzi nke Nzukọ (354–430), onye chegharịrị site n'ekpere nne ya, Nsọ Monika. O dere Nkwupụta.
Saint Monica: Nne nke Nsọ Ọgọstin, onye nwetara nchegharị nwa ya mgbe ọtụtụ afọ nke ekpere kwesịrị ntụkwasị obi gasịrị. Onye Nchekwa ndị nne na ndị nwanyị lụrụ di.
Saint Sebastian: Onye agha Rom e gburu n'ihi okwukwe n'oge Diocletian ihe dị ka 288. Onye Nchekwa ndị agha na ndị egwuregwu.
Saint Lawrence: Dikon nke Rom nwụrụ n'ihi okwukwe na 258, onye gosiri ndị ogbenye dịka ezi akụ nke Nzukọ. Onye Nchekwa ndị dikon na ndị ogbenye.
Saint Stephen: Otu n'ime dikon asaa mbụ na onye mbụ nwụrụ n'ihi okwukwe nke Nzukọ, onye nwụrụ ka ọ na-ekpere ndị na-atụ ya nkume ekpere.
Saint Nicholas: Bishọp nke Myra na narị afọ nke anọ, a hụrụ n'anya maka obi ebere ya na onyinye nzuzo ya. Onye Nchekwa ụmụaka na ndị ọkwọ ụgbọ mmiri.
Saint George: Onye agha na onye nwụrụ n'ihi okwukwe na mmalite narị afọ nke anọ, ihe nlereanya nke obi ike n'okwukwe. Onye Nchekwa ndị agha na ndị Scout.
James the Great: Onyeozi na nwanne Nsọ Jọn, onye mbụ n'ime Iri na Abụọ nwụrụ n'ihi okwukwe. Ebe nsọ ya na Santiago de Compostela na-adọta ndị njem nsọ na Camino. Onye Nchekwa nke Spain.
Andrew the Apostle: Nwanne Nsọ Pita na Onyeozi mbụ a kpọrọ, onye kpọtaara Pita Jizọs. E gburu ya n'obe na Patras. Onye Nchekwa nke Scotland.
Martin of Tours: Onye agha Rom kesara uwe mkpuchi ya na onye arịrịọ, mesịa ghọọ Bishọp nke Tours (nwụrụ 397). Onye Nchekwa ndị agha.
Benedict of Nursia: Nna nke ndụ ndị mọnk n'Ọdịda Anyanwụ (ihe dị ka 480–547), onye Iwu ekpere na ọrụ ya duziri ndị mọnk ruo ọtụtụ narị afọ. Onye Nchekwa nke Europe.
Saint Dominic: Onye guzobere Otu Ndị Nkwusa (1170–1221), onye raara onwe ya nye ikwusa eziokwu na Rosari.
Ignatius of Loyola: Onye agha ghọrọ onye nsọ (1491–1556), onye guzobere Otu Jizọs ma dee Mmega Ahụ nke Mmụọ, ihe niile "maka ebube ka ukwuu nke Chineke."
Charles Borromeo: Achịbishọp nke Milan (1538–1584) meghariri Nzukọ mgbe Kansụl Trent gasịrị ma lekọta ndị ọrịa n'oge ọrịa na-efe efe.
Elizabeth Ann Seton: Nwunye, nne, nwanyị di ya nwụrụ na onye chegharịrị (1774–1821), onye guzobere Ụmụ Nwanyị Nsọ nke Ọrụ Ebere na ụlọ akwụkwọ Katọlik na Amerika. Onye nsọ mbụ a mụrụ na United States.
Isidore the Laborer: Onye ọrụ ugbo na Madrid (nwụrụ 1130), onye kwesịrị ntụkwasị obi n'Emume Mas kwa ụbọchị ma na-enye ndị ogbenye aka. Onye Nchekwa ndị ọrụ ugbo.
Saint Lucy: Nwa agbọghọ na-amaghị nwoke na onye nwụrụ n'ihi okwukwe na Syracuse (nwụrụ 304), onye aha ya pụtara "ìhè." Onye Nchekwa ndị kpuru ìsì.
Saint Cecilia: Nwa agbọghọ na-amaghị nwoke na onye nwụrụ n'ihi okwukwe na Rom, onye na-abụrụ Chineke abụ n'obi ya. Onye Nchekwa ndị egwu na egwu nsọ.
Clare of Assisi: Onye na-eso Nsọ Francis (1194–1253) na onye guzobere Ndị Clare Ogbenye, onye raara onwe ya nye ịda ogbenye na Sakramenti A Gọziri Agọzi.
Pope John Paul II: Pope site na 1978 ruo 2005, a mụrụ dịka Karol Wojtyła na Poland, onye njem nsọ na-adịghị ike gwụ nke gwara ụwa "atụla egwu." E mere ya onye nsọ na 2014.
Pope Pius X: Pope site na 1903 ruo 1914 kwalitere ịnata Oriri Nsọ ugboro ugboro ma mepee ya nye ụmụntakịrị, "imeghari ihe niile n'ime Kraịst."
Luke the Evangelist: Dọkịta na enyi Nsọ Pọl, onye dere Oziọma Luk na Ọrụ Ndịozi. Onye Nchekwa ndị dọkịta na ndị na-ese ihe.
Mark the Evangelist: Enyi Nsọ Pita na onye dere Oziọma Mak. Onye Nchekwa nke Venice.
Matthew the Apostle: Onye ọnakọ ụtụ isi Jizọs kpọrọ ka ọ bụrụ Onyeozi, onye dere Oziọma mbụ.
Bartholomew the Apostle: Otu n'ime Iri na Abụọ, onye Onyenwe anyị kpọrọ "ezi onye Izrel nke aghụghọ na-adịghị n'ime ya," kwusara Oziọma ma nwụọ n'ihi okwukwe.
Helena, mother of Constantine I: Eze nwanyị na nne Constantine Onye Ukwu, onye chọtara ezi Obe n'oge njem nsọ ya na Jerusalem.
Brigid of Kildare: Onyeisi ndị nwanyị nsọ na Kildare (nwụrụ ihe dị ka 525), a hụrụ n'anya maka obi ebere ya na ile ọbịa. Onye Nchekwa nke Ireland.
Louis IX of France: Eze France (1214–1270), onye ọchịchị ezi omume raara onwe ya nye ekpere na ndị ogbenye.
